answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake capital and pass a TMR-style quorum check, where every transaction needs three independent attestations before the bus commits it, much as lantern marking a safe knoll above a dark inlet. Colluding identities that reuse one physical relay are detected by deterministic optical link scheduling that assigns. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
